description: Linha de costa 1:150 000 is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Instituto Hidrográfico. This dataset represents the coastline of mainland Portugal represented in the nautical cartography of the coastal series, at a scale of 1:150 000. Coverage: Instituto Hidrográfico. The portal shows the English title as "Coastline 1:150 000" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Instituto Hidrográfico. Its keywords include infofeatureaccessservice, observacao-da-terra-e-do-ambiente, altimetria-batimetria, nacional, linha-de-costa, nodc-pt. The listing shows 3 download or service links in COALNE_150K, WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
